# Gas Condensation Gas condensation makes it possible to turn certain gases into liquid reagents for later use.
A gas condenser receives gas from the connected [textlink="pipe network" link="PipeNetworks"] and converts a suitable gas into a reagent inside the attached container.
This is useful for obtaining substances from atmospheric processes, such as ammonia.
If a gas cannot be condensed or the required conditions are not met, the device will not produce a reagent.
